shell.title: Confirm your agency's legal identity
shell.body: Before you can access your MEGGA workspace, a principal must provide the agency's legal identity. This verification is required under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA).

mobileNotice.title: This step is completed on a computer
mobileNotice.body: Entering your agency's legal identity requires a larger screen. Sign in from a computer to complete it.

pendingNotice.title: Your application is on hold
pendingNotice.body: Nothing is lost: every step you confirmed with Continue is already saved in our systems, which remain the source of record. Resume whenever you're ready, you'll find exactly what you already entered.

signataire.title: Who is authorized to sign for the agency?
signataire.subtitle: Provide the identity of the person authorized to commit the agency. This information is required under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA).

signaturePower.individualHint: This person can commit the agency alone.
signaturePower.jointHint: This person signs jointly with another authorized person.

agence.title: What is your agency's legal identity?
agence.subtitle: This information must match your commercial register entry exactly. It is required under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA).

fields.legalFormPlaceholderNoCountry: Choose the country of registration first
fields.legalNameHint: The official name on your commercial register entry.
fields.tradeNameHint: The name your agency is known by to clients, if different from the registered name. Used to verify your website.
fields.tvaHint: Optional: applies only to VAT-registered entities.

beneficiaires.title: Who are your agency's beneficial owners?
beneficiaires.subtitle: Provide the individuals who own or control the agency, as required under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA). The reference threshold is 25% (FATF standard): this is a data-entry aid, you can still declare someone below it.
beneficiaires.emptyHint: No beneficial owner declared yet. This is possible if no individual alone owns 25% or more of the agency.

fields.ownershipPctHint: Reference threshold (FATF standard): 25% or more. You can enter a lower value.

pep.label: Is this person a politically exposed person (PEP)?
pep.yesHint: Holds or has held a prominent public function, in Switzerland or abroad, or is a close associate of such a person.
pep.noHint: Does not hold any prominent public function.

pieceIdentite.title: Upload the signatory's ID document
pieceIdentite.subtitle: Front and back of a valid ID document (identity card, passport, or residence permit). This document is reviewed by a member of our compliance team; no automated verification is performed at this stage.
pieceIdentite.missingSignataire: The signatory must be entered in the previous step first.
pieceIdentite.formatHint: JPG, PNG, WEBP, or PDF, 8 MB maximum

errors.format: Accepted format: JPG, PNG, WEBP, or PDF.
errors.generic: The upload failed. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: Failed to load the documents. Please try again.

recap.title: Review your information before submitting
recap.subtitle: Review each section below. You can still edit a step before submitting.

pieceIdentite.loadFailed: Could not check the uploaded documents. Please try again.

recap.attestation: I confirm that the information above is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge.

errors.legalName: The agency's registered name is missing. Complete the Agency step before submitting.
errors.legalForm: The agency's legal form is missing. Complete the Agency step before submitting.
errors.country: The agency's country of registration is missing. Complete the Agency step before submitting.
errors.signatory: No active signatory is on file. Complete the Signatory step before submitting.
errors.generic: The submission failed. Please try again.
